title: 第5章 区区两百两就想收买我第6章 放弃吧你不行
content_zh:
天牢巡视，分为早中晚三班。
陈观楼跟在卢大头身边，干了小半个月的白班，轮班的时候不出意外被分在了晚班。
一群老油条，晚上闸门一关，没有上官盯着，一个个都不耐烦值班。陈观楼便担任起晚班巡视的重任，独自走在暗无天日的丙字号大牢的长长甬道内。
经过十三号牢房，他照例敲击了一下牢房栅栏。里面的犯人一如既往像是蛆似的蠕动了两下，证明还活着。当差这么长时间，他还没见过十三号房犯人的真面目。
真能趴啊！
一路往深处走。
“小哥，小哥……”
二十五号牢房的胖子，一个胖子，身处天牢，可是很少见的。关键是身上还没有伤。从第一天当差起，陈观楼就注意到对方，放高利贷的有活力的社会团体的小头目，据说是得罪了贵人，找了个由头被关进了天牢。
“小哥，这里……”
“什么事？”陈观楼不假辞色，神情严肃。
可他毕竟年轻，落在这帮老油条犯人眼中，就有点色厉内荏，装腔作势，底气不足。看起来是个好忽悠的新丁。
“小哥帮我一个忙，帮我带句话给外面，一百两。”
陈观楼扭头就走，都不耐烦和对方浪费一个字。
胖子顿时急了，“小哥请慢。一百五十两……实在不行，两百两。到底行不行，小哥你给句实在话啊！”
陈观楼理都不理他，连个正眼都懒得给对方。对方明显将他当傻子玩弄。两百两的买卖，这么好的事情，胖子怎么不找其他狱卒传话，偏偏找上他这个新丁。别告诉他，胖子好心，特意照顾他这个新丁。
胖子不是个好人！
他又不是三岁小孩，岂能被区区两百两银子收买。
卢大头再三强调，严防内外串通。必定是因为之前天牢出过内外串通造成严重后果的大事。他一个新丁，没家世没背景，又是刚来，哪来的胆量敢玩内外串通的把戏。只怕有命赚钱没命花。
不理会胖子的糖衣炮弹，他继续巡视牢房，一间间清点人数，确定犯人都还活着。
巡视到六十号牢房，他特意多看了两眼。之前他就打听清楚了，六十号牢房关押的是老鹰门的帮主。

老鹰门名为武馆，实为有活力的社会团体。明面上干着合法的买卖，背地里却干着杀人越货的勾当。前段时间被六扇门端掉。
陈观楼之所以注意此人，是他多日观察，综合考量后，认为对方是比较好打交道的人。且，对方是有真功夫在身，堂堂一品武者，已经入了武道。开武馆的时候，也担着教导门下弟子的职责。对他来说是个机会。
他可没忘记自己来天牢当差的使命。
学武！
老鹰门帮主姓罗，大名罗敬天，是个中年莽汉。他显然也注意到陈观楼，知道这是天牢新来的狱卒。
“小哥！”
多日观察，他还是忍不住开了口。
“何事？”陈观楼不假辞色，站在牢房外，表情冷漠无情。
“帮个忙，搞点酒菜来吃。我给钱。”罗敬天舔了舔舌头，一身的伤痕，显然被用了刑。
陈观楼冷哼一声，扭头就走。
尽管想要接触对方，却也不能轻易让对方得逞。
content_en:
Tianlao inspections are divided into three shifts: morning, afternoon and evening.
Chen Guanlou followed Lu Datou and worked the day shift for less than half a month. As expected during the shift, he was assigned to the night shift.
A group of old fritters, when the gate is closed at night and there is no superior to watch, all of them are impatient to be on duty. Chen Guanlou took on the important task of patrolling the evening shift and walked alone in the long corridor of the dark No. C prison.
Passing Cell 13, he knocked on the cell fence as usual. The prisoner inside squirmed twice like a maggot as usual, proving that he was still alive. He has never seen the true face of the prisoner in Room 13 after being on duty for so long.
You can really lie down!
Go all the way deeper.
"Brother, little brother..."
The fat man in Cell No. 25 is a rare fat man in a sky prison. The key is that there are no injuries on the body. From the first day on duty, Chen Guanlou noticed the other party. He was the small leader of a dynamic social group that engaged in loan sharking. It was said that he had offended a noble person and found an excuse to be imprisoned in the sky jail.
"Brother, here..."
"What's the matter?" Chen Guanlou spoke without pretense and looked serious.
But he was young after all, and in the eyes of these veteran prisoners, he was a bit stern, pretentious, and lacking in confidence. He seems to be a good newcomer.
"Brother, do me a favor and bring a message to the outside world, one hundred taels."
Chen Guanlou turned around and left, impatient to waste a word with the other party.
The fat man suddenly became anxious, "Brother, please be slow. One hundred and fifty taels... It really doesn't work, two hundred taels. Is it okay? Brother, tell me the truth!"
Chen Guanlou ignored him and didn't even bother to look at him. The other party was obviously playing him like a fool. A deal of two hundred taels, such a good thing, why didn't the fat man go to other jailers to spread the word, but he went to him as a newcomer? Don't tell him that Fatty is kind-hearted and specially takes care of him as a newcomer.
Fat people are not good people!
He is not a three-year-old child, how can he be bribed with a mere two hundred taels of silver.
Lu Datou repeatedly emphasized that internal and external collusion must be strictly guarded against. It must be because there have been major incidents in Tianlao where internal and external collusion caused serious consequences. He was a newcomer, with no family background and no background, and he had just arrived. How could he have the courage to play tricks of collusion between internal and external parties? I'm just afraid that I have my life to make money but not my life to spend it.
Ignoring Fatty's sugar-coated bullets, he continued to patrol the cells, counting people in each cell to make sure that all the prisoners were still alive.
When he inspected Cell No. 60, he took a special look twice. He had found out before that Cell No. 60 held the leader of the Eagle Gate gang.
The Eagle Gate is called a martial arts school, but it is actually a dynamic social group. On the surface, they are engaged in legal business, but behind the scenes, they are engaged in murder and smuggling. It was taken away by Six Doors some time ago.
The reason why Chen Guanlou paid attention to this person was that he had observed him for many days and after comprehensive consideration, he thought that the other person was an easier person to deal with. Moreover, the other party has real skills, a dignified first-class warrior, and has already entered the martial arts. When he opened a martial arts gym, he was also responsible for teaching his disciples. It's an opportunity for him.
He has not forgotten his mission in Tianlao.
Learn martial arts!
The leader of the Eagle Gate Gang is named Luo, and his given name is Luo Jingtian. He is a middle-aged man. He obviously also noticed Chen Guanlou and knew that he was the new jailer from Tianlao.
"Brother!"
After many days of observation, he still couldn't help but speak.
"What's the matter?" Chen Guanlou said without any pretense, standing outside the cell with a cold and ruthless expression.
"Do me a favor and get some food and drinks. I'll give you the money." Luo Jingtian licked his tongue. The scars all over his body showed that he had been tortured.
Chen Guanlou snorted coldly, turned around and left.
Although you want to contact the other party, you cannot let the other party succeed easily.
